name: Invitation Homes
description: Invitation Homes owns and rents out single-family houses in 16 US markets, mostly in the Western US, Florida and the Southeast. At December 31, 2025 it wholly owned 86,192 homes (averaging about 1,880 square feet, three to four bedrooms), jointly owned 8,006 more with partners, and managed a further 15,866 for third parties. Nearly all revenue is rent: residents sign one- to two-year leases, pay monthly, and can leave at the end of the term, so income tracks rents, occupancy and turnover rather than long-term contracts. A small second income is management fees from running homes owned by joint ventures and other owners. Growth comes from buying newly built homes from homebuilders, developing build-to-rent homes, and since January 2026 building through its own homebuilder ResiBuilt.

businessLines.name: Rental revenues and other property income (owned homes)
businessLines.shareBasis: 2,641,957 / 2,729,296 total revenues, computed from FY2025 10-K figures
businessLines.how: Residents pay monthly rent under one- to two-year leases directly to Invitation Homes; revenue is driven by average monthly rent, occupancy, collection rate and how many days a home sits empty between residents, with add-on charges for services and utilities on top.
businessLines.description: Rent from the wholly owned single-family homes, plus other property income: resident reimbursements for utilities and HOA fines, value-add services (smart-home, internet and media packages, home liability insurance, HVAC filters), late and lease-termination fees, and pet rent and deposits.

businessLines.name: Management fee revenues (third-party and joint-venture homes)
businessLines.shareBasis: 87,339 / 2,729,296 total revenues, computed from FY2025 10-K figures
businessLines.how: Owners of the managed homes pay Invitation Homes a fee for running and administering their portfolios; the fee scales with the number of homes and the rent collected, and the largest payers are the company's own joint ventures.
businessLines.description: Property and asset management services for homes owned by portfolio owners, including Invitation Homes's unconsolidated joint ventures. 15,866 homes managed for others at 2025-12-31 and 15,639 at 2026-06-30.

businessLines.name: ResiBuilt (fee homebuilding and development)
businessLines.how: Builds and develops rental homes and communities, both as a fee-based general contractor for third parties and to feed Invitation Homes's own build-to-rent pipeline.
businessLines.description: Fee homebuilder for single-family rental communities in Southeast markets, acquired January 14, 2026. Not yet a separately reported line; its revenue is not broken out in the sources read.
